info.title: GauntletCI.Cli
info.description: GauntletCI is a .NET pre-commit and PR integration gate that evaluates diffs against 42 behavioral-change rules — catching unvalidated changes, missing tests, async deadlock risk, security risks, and resource lifecycle violations before code is committed or merged. Optional local LLM enrichment via Ollama. Built-in MCP server for AI assistant integration. Fully offline — no data leaves your machine. Open source CodeRabbit alternative with deterministic, auditable findings.
